title: Triangular equations generate the evaluation kernel of a finite algebraic tower
statement: Let k and K be fields [def-weil-field] with a k-algebra structure [def-pc-field-extension]. Let x : Fin(d) → K be a transcendence basis [def-weil-pbc-transcendence-basis], and let b : Fin(m) → K be any finite family, not necessarily generating K. There exist a nonzero h in k[X_0,...,X_{d-1}] [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], monic p_i in k[X_0,...,X_{d+i}][Z], and y : Fin(d+1+m) → K such that y_j = x_j for j<d, y_d = h(x)^{-1}, and y_{d+1+i} = b_i. The kernel of the evaluation k-algebra map at y [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] is exactly the ideal generated by triangularFieldModelEquations(k,d,m,h,p) [def-weil-pbc-triangular-field-model-equations, def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]. No fraction representation of arbitrary elements of K is claimed.

proof.text: Let F = k(x). Algebraic independence identifies k[X] with k[x], whose fraction field is F. The transcendence basis makes every b_i algebraic over F. Put L_i = F(b_j : j < i); this finite tower need not reach K.

proof.text: Each b_i has a monic minimal polynomial of positive degree over L_i. The minimal-polynomial quotient isomorphism and its power basis, followed by Basis.smulTower at each step, give an F-basis of L_m consisting of the products of b_i with exponents strictly below the respective minimal-polynomial degrees. The same construction gives the preceding bases needed to expand coefficients. L_m need not equal K, and no separability is needed.

proof.text: *The polynomials $P_i$ over $F$.* Fix $i$ and write $\mu_i=T^{e_i}+\sum_{l<e_i}c_{il}T^l$ with $c_{il}\in L_{i-1}$. By step 2 each $c_{il}$ is an $F$-linear combination of monomials in $b_1,\dots,b_{i-1}$; replacing $b_j$ by the variable $Y_j$ gives $g_{il}\in F[Y_1,\dots,Y_{i-1}]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] with $g_{il}(b_1,\dots,b_{i-1})=c_{il}$. Put $P_i:=Y_i^{e_i}+\sum_{l<e_i}g_{il}Y_i^l\in F[Y_1,\dots,Y_i]$. Then $P_i$ is monic of degree $e_i$ in $Y_i$ with coefficients in $F[Y_1,\dots,Y_{i-1}]$, and $P_i(b_1,\dots,b_i)=\mu_i(b_i)=0$ in $K$.

proof.text: Lift each coefficient a/h^j to a(X) T^j, preserving the leading coefficient one. Assemble the resulting equations using [def-weil-pbc-triangular-field-model-equations]. The localization presentation identifies quotienting by hT - 1 with adjoining 1/h. Taking the further quotient by the lifted monic equations identifies the explicit polynomial quotient A with B = D[Y]/(P).

proof.text: *$B_i$ is free over $D$.* For $0\le i\le r$ put $B_i:=D[Y_1,\dots,Y_i]/(P_1,\dots,P_i)$ and $E_i:=\prod_{j\le i}\{0,\dots,e_j-1\}$. Claim: the classes of $Y^\varepsilon$, $\varepsilon\in E_i$, form a basis of $B_i$ as a $D$-module [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. For $i=0$, $B_0=D$ with basis $\{1\}$. For $i\ge1$: $P_1,\dots,P_{i-1}$ do not involve $Y_i$, so taking the quotient in two stages $B_i\cong B_{i-1}[Y_i]/(\bar P_i)$, $\bar P_i$ the image of $P_i$, which is monic of degree $e_i$ in $Y_i$ (step 4). By [lem-weil-pbc-monic-quotient-free], $1,Y_i,\dots,Y_i^{e_i-1}$ is a $B_{i-1}$-basis of $B_i$, and by the induction hypothesis and [lem-weil-pbc-tower-product-basis] (for $D\to B_{i-1}$ and the $B_{i-1}$-module $B_i$) the products $Y^\varepsilon Y_i^l$, i.e. the $Y^{\varepsilon'}$, $\varepsilon'\in E_i$, form a $D$-basis of $B_i$.

proof.text: Evaluation at x, h(x) inverse, and b kills all displayed relations. Under the localization and successive quotient identifications of step 5, the quotient has the D-basis of bounded monomials in step 6. Their images are the F-basis of L_m from step 2, so every element in the evaluation kernel has all D-coefficients zero. Thus the quotient evaluates injectively and the evaluation kernel on the polynomial ring is exactly the ideal of the displayed equations. If m = 0 take h = 1 and T = 1; if d = 0 the base fraction field is k. Repetitions yield degree-one minimal polynomials and no separability is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_triangularFieldModel_evaluation_kernel
    (k : Type u) (K : Type v) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (d : ℕ) (x : Fin d → K) (hx : IsTranscendenceBasis k x)
    (m : ℕ) (b : Fin m → K) :
    ∃ (h : MvPolynomial (Fin d) k)
      (p : (i : Fin m) → Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin (d + 1 + i.val)) k))
      (y : Fin (d + 1 + m) → K),
      h ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ i, (p i).Monic) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin d, y ⟨j.val, by omega⟩ = x j) ∧
      y ⟨d, by omega⟩ = (MvPolynomial.aeval x h)⁻¹ ∧
      (∀ i : Fin m, y ⟨d + 1 + i.val, by omega⟩ = b i) ∧
      RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval y).toRingHom =
        Ideal.ofList (triangularFieldModelEquations k d m h p)
